plain.text: God said to Jacob, "Go up to Bethel and settle there, and build an altar to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother." Jacob told his household to get rid of their foreign gods, purify themselves and change their clothes. They gave him their idols and earrings, and he buried them under an oak at Shechem. As they set out, a terror from God fell on the surrounding towns so no one pursued them. At Bethel Jacob built an altar. Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died and was buried there. God appeared to Jacob again and blessed him: "Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel. I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a community of nations will come from you, and kings will be among your descendants. The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I give to you." Jacob set up a stone pillar and called the place Bethel.

As they travelled on from Bethel towards Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and had great difficulty. The midwife said, "Don't be afraid, for you have another son." As she was dying, Rachel named him Ben-Oni ("son of my sorrow"), but his father named him Benjamin ("son of my right hand"). Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath, that is, Bethlehem. Jacob set up a pillar over her tomb.

Israel moved on. While he was living in that region, Reuben slept with Bilhah, his father's concubine, and Israel heard about it. Jacob had twelve sons: Leah's sons Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun; Rachel's sons Joseph and Benjamin; Bilhah's sons Dan and Naphtali; and Zilpah's sons Gad and Asher.
Jacob came home to his father Isaac at Mamre, near Hebron. Isaac lived 180 years. He died, old and full of years, and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

summary.bigIdea: Jacob's household turns from idols, God renews his promise at Bethel, Benjamin is born, and Rachel and Isaac die.
points: Jacob tells his household to get rid of their idols and goes back to Bethel.
God confirms Jacob's new name, Israel, and the promise of a nation and land.
Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin; Jacob now has twelve sons; Isaac dies.
summary.reflection: Jacob's family buried their idols before meeting God. Is there anything you would need to put aside to follow God more fully?
